title: Wildvine
wikitext:
'''Wildvine''' is an [[herb]] that can be gathered with [[Herbalism]] (210). Wildvine is not gathered independently, but rather has a roughly 10% chance to drop while gathering [[Purple Lotus]]. It can also be found dropping from the [[Skullsplitter tribe|Skullsplitter]] trolls in [[Stranglethorn Vale]] or the [[Witherbark tribe|Witherbark]] and [[Vilebranch]] trolls in [[The Hinterlands]].
